raw_reinspection_regions.normalized_text: Let $O(n):=\{O\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n}:O^{\top}O=I_{n}\}$ denote the real orthogonal group, equipped with Haar probability measure. It has two components, $\{\det O=+1\}$ , $\{\det O=-1\}$ , and each have Haar probability $1/2$ . For $b\in\{-1,+1\}$ , we write $\mu_{n,b}$ for Haar probability measure conditioned on $\det O=b$ .

We study the problem of sampling from a centered Gaussian distribution given query access to its unnormalized density. Gaussian sampling is a fundamental algorithmic task with applications in Bayesian inference [ 7 ] , numerical simulation [ 11 ] , and randomized approximation algorithms [ 16 ] .
